question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who is well-versed in many languages
solution:
The correct answer is **Polyglot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate one-word substitute for the given group of words '**One who is well-versed in many languages**' is '**Polyglot**'.
 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Verbose**- using or expressing in more words than are needed.
 
• **Linguist**- a person who studies linguistics.
 
• **Stalwart**- loyal, reliable, and hard-working.
